# Dijup Tuladhar

> Product Designer, Builder & Founder. 20+ years crafting design systems, AI-enabled products, and agile experiences. Based in Kathmandu, Nepal, working globally.

## Summary
Dijup Tuladhar is a Senior Principal Product Designer, entrepreneur, and strategic product leader with over two decades of experience bridging design excellence, AI innovation, and agile execution. He is the founder and full-stack builder of Chordpedia, Nepal's flagship music chords and lyrics platform, scaling it organically to over 82,000 users and 400+ active musicians. At Cotiviti and Infinite Computer Solutions, he has spearheaded design systems and UX architecture for multi-million-dollar healthcare analytics platforms.

## Core Expertise
- **Design-Led Agility**: Integrating Design Sprints with SAFe 5 and Scrum engineering sprints to eliminate waste.
- **Enterprise Design Systems**: Multi-brand Figma token architectures synchronized with React and React Native codebases.
- **AI Product Strategy & UX**: Designing agentic workflows, LLM prompt interfaces, and human-in-the-loop AI systems.
- **Full-Cycle Product Building**: Hands-on architecture with React, TypeScript, React Native, PHP, MySQL, and Web Audio APIs.
- **Healthcare UX**: Clinical data visualization, HIPAA-compliant interfaces, and progressive disclosure design.

## Ventures & Leadership
- **Chordpedia** (https://chordpedia.com): Founder & Developer. Bootstrapped Nepal's largest guitar & ukulele chords platform. Facebook FbStart recipient.
- **Infinite Computer Solutions**: Senior Principal Product Designer (2024–Present), leading global enterprise product design and AI UX workflows.
- **Cotiviti** (formerly D2Hawkeye / Verscend): Sr. Principal Creative Designer (2008–Present), 16+ years designing clinical intelligence platforms.

## Key Articles & Insights
- [Building Chordpedia](https://dijup.com/articles/building-chordpedia): Architectural and product lessons from creating Nepal's premier music platform.
- [AI Won't Replace Designers](https://dijup.com/articles/ai-wont-replace-designers): The transition of design leadership from drafting pixels to strategic AI curation.
- [Healthcare UX Insights](https://dijup.com/articles/healthcare-ux-insights): Designing high-stakes clinical interfaces under high cognitive load.
- [React Native Design Systems](https://dijup.com/articles/react-native-design-systems): Bridging design tokens to cross-platform mobile production.
